context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren reflect on last year.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business review; vocabulary (去年/かける/させる/正しく/伴う) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 去年は、よく頑張ってくれたな。
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm composed approving clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 去年は、準備に時間をかけました。
lines.en: Last year I spent time on preparation.
lines.style: reliable young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: チームを、よくまとめさせたね。
lines.en: You had the team well organized.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 皆に、正しく役割を分けさせました。
lines.en: I had everyone's roles divided correctly.
lines.style: confident young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 成長には、苦労が伴うものだ。
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 苦労が伴っても、正しく進めました。
lines.en: Even with hardship, I proceeded correctly.
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今年も、時間をかけて育てよう。
lines.en: This year too, let's nurture it over time.
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 去年の経験を、活かします。
lines.en: I'll make use of last year's experience.
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
